Founded in December 2021 by former SenseTime researchers, MiniMax has built a multimodal AI platform spanning text, audio, image, video, and music generation. The company completed a landmark Hong Kong Stock Exchange IPO in January 2026, raising approximately HK$4.8 billion (~$619 million), and has become one of the most well-capitalized Chinese AI labs.

claims.text: MiniMax: Comprehensive Research Report (2026) ## Executive Summary MiniMax Group (MiniMax AI, Chinese: 稀宇科技, Xīyǔ Kējì ) is a Shanghai-based artificial intelligence company that has emerged as one of China's leading AI startups, often classified among the "AI Tigers" alongside Moonshot AI (Kimi), DeepSeek, and Zhipu AI.
Founded in December 2021 by former SenseTime researchers, MiniMax has built a multimodal AI platform spanning text, audio, image, video, and music generation.
The company completed a landmark Hong Kong Stock Exchange IPO in January 2026, raising approximately HK$4.8 billion (~$619 million), and has become one of the most well-capitalized Chinese AI labs.
As of mid-2026, MiniMax's flagship models include the M2 series (M2, M2.1, M2.5, M2.7) and the newly released M3.0 (June 2026) with 1M token context window and native multimodality.
